◆ WORLDSCOPE

Design Prototypes

Exploratory directions for the daily brief surface, all rendered on the real 2026-05-31 briefing content. These are mockups for review — not the production site.

↳ The interactive ones (K, K2, L) need JavaScript/CSS that in-app file previews strip out. Opened here as real web pages, they work. Click into a card and interact.
Interactive — open these first
L · Living terminal

Types to you, time-aware

Light terminal that types the brief out line by line; background blends through the day and carries a world-state tone-wash. Ask-anything line.

watch ~10s
K2 · Spatial deck (no-JS)

Slide-panel navigator

The day as a row of columns; click to glide focus — one expands, the rest stay quiet slivers. Pure CSS, works anywhere. ◐ theme toggle.

click around
K · Spatial deck (JS)

Push-stack navigator

Same idea, dynamic: click a story and a panel slides in; chain entities deeper; breadcrumb + arrow-key nav. Needs JS — works in a browser.

click around
Static directions
I · Quiet luxury

Single calm column

Thin Fraunces display, huge whitespace, one hairline rule between movements. The anti-dashboard.
J · 2040 neo-grotesk

Dark, oversized gauge

Space Grotesk, a gradient posture number, glowing priority dots. The most product-forward.
D · Refined mix

Coded-color Swiss

Swiss bones; college colors as a signal system (legend at the foot); adaptive light/dark from one token set.
H · Maroon dossier

Classified register

Deep ASU-maroon header band, gold rule, Spectral serif, "Eyes Only" stamp. Authoritative.
F · Atlas

Cartographic

Coordinate-grid paper, monospace, an event map with strike pins and the watch-box lat/lon.
G · Console

Dense panels

Dark Bloomberg-style multi-panel: markets table, anomaly bars, sparkline, quiet list — all at once.
E · Broadsheet

Newspaper of record

Big Fraunces masthead, three-column deck, maroon drop-cap, double rules.
A · Editorial-intelligence

Newsprint dossier

Serif headlines, two-column lede with a live markets/anomaly rail, ruled watch-area ledger.
B · Modern dark

Terminal cards

Dark canvas, teal accent, sticky nav, ticker strip, red priority bars.
C · Swiss / brutalist

Hard grid

Everything boxed, Helvetica + mono, uppercase, one signal red. Severe.
